data: What is the size of the training set corresponding to the highest BLEU score for the 'Baseline' system?

The caption states that the figure shows the English-Turkish BLEU over training set size. The x-axis represents the number of training sentences in thousands, ranging from 25 to 210. The y-axis represents the Dev set BLEU (single system). The lines represent two systems: PostNorm (blue line with circles) and Baseline (orange dashed line with plus signs).

To find the size of the training set corresponding to the highest BLEU score for the 'Baseline' system, I need to look at the orange dashed line (Baseline) and identify its peak point. The peak point appears to be around 117.5 on the x-axis, which corresponds to approximately 117,500 training sentences. Therefore, the size of the training set corresponding to the highest BLEU score for the 'Baseline' system is approximately 117,500.
